三个快捷按钮只准备选择；确认后才执行。: The three quick choices only prepare a decision; nothing runs until you confirm.
保留本地或合并内容会创建 PR/MR；不会直接覆盖目标分支。使用远端只更新草稿，: Keeping local changes or merging creates a PR/MR and never overwrites the target branch directly. Using remote only updates the draft.
将先保存草稿历史，再导入当前远端正文；不会写远端。: Saves draft history, then imports the current remote document without writing remotely.
将在独立分支提交并创建 PR/MR，目标分支不会被直接覆盖。: Commits on a separate branch and creates a PR/MR without directly overwriting the target branch.
将更新草稿并通过 PR/MR 交付合并结果。: Updates the draft and delivers the merged result through a PR/MR.
打开三方对比，不会直接覆盖远端: Open the three-way comparison without directly overwriting the remote
请关闭面板并重新运行发布预检。: Close this panel and run publish preflight again.
选择“合并双方内容”后可编辑: Editable after choosing Merge Both Versions
远端基线文件已不存在。: The remote baseline file no longer exists.
无法读取远端基线：%@: Could not read the remote baseline: %@
本地草稿没有记录远端基线。: The local draft has no recorded remote baseline.

提供商没有返回可读取的文件正文。: The provider did not return readable file content.
文件超过可视化合并上限（%lld KB）。: The file exceeds the visual merge limit (%lld KB).
文件包含二进制数据，不能作为文本合并。: The file contains binary data and cannot be merged as text.
文件不是有效的 UTF-8 文本。: The file is not valid UTF-8 text.

发布包已变化，已停止冲突处理；请重新审阅发布清单。: The publish package changed, so conflict resolution stopped. Review the publish checklist again.
远端内容已变化且当前冲突不再存在，请重新审阅发布清单。: Remote content changed and this conflict no longer exists. Review the publish checklist again.

已采用远端版本：%@；没有写入远端。: Adopted the remote version: %@. Nothing was written remotely.
最终合并版无效、过大或仍含 Git 冲突标记，未修改草稿。: The final merge is invalid, too large, or still contains Git conflict markers. The draft was not changed.
